summary.scope: All50 Magebean automation backlog requirements; feasibility review, not implemented automation or certification.

requirements.rationale: Effective write access is a machine property when the deployment runtime identities and mount namespace are known. Current strict mode checks all Unix write bits, so owner-writable code can falsely fail even when the web worker cannot write; ACLs and read-only mounts are not evaluated.
required_inputs: Runtime UID, supplementary groups, capabilities and mount namespace for each application worker
Complete app/vendor/lib inventory, symlink targets, ACLs and mount flags
requirements.proposed_check: Evaluate effective create/replace/write permissions for every code object and containing directory under every declared runtime identity using an OS-aware read-only evaluator. PASS requires complete inventory and no writable object; any confirmed writable object FAIL; unsupported capability, namespace or ACL semantics UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Deployment-owner write bit with distinct nonwriter web UID; read-only runtime bind mount.
tests.fail: ACL grants web UID write, writable parent allows code replacement, or runtime group can write.
tests.missing: Unidentified worker, uncollected ACL, external symlink or mount namespace yields UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Active IDs only cover world-write/env ownership policy. Never infer runtime access from scanner UID or mode bits alone.
requirements.criterion: Code directories are read-only for the application runtime in the collected Magento deployment; assess effective runtime identity, permissions, ACLs and read-only mounts.

requirements.rationale: An ACL string anywhere in repository config and an unseen login page do not prove ingress restriction. The current check can PASS on ACL hints even if the effective virtual host does not apply them.
required_inputs: Known Admin route and explicit ingress endpoint list
Machine readable active gateway policy tied to endpoint and known denied/allowed probe perspectives
requirements.proposed_check: New ID: each named Admin endpoint returns an explicit access denial from the configured untrusted probe origin, with active ACL bindings showing the protected route. Reachable login FAIL; ambiguous 200/404, redirect, unknown origin or unavailable binding UNKNOWN. No password submission.

tests.safe: Known forbidden-origin probe gets bound gateway 403 while authenticated health probe confirms route exists.
tests.fail: Admin login body reachable from forbidden origin despite unrelated ACL hint.
tests.missing: Unknown route/origin, 404 catch-all, WAF challenge, transport failure or partial endpoint set UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: New ID required for endpoint/origin-scoped denial; cannot establish restriction from all networks or gateway bypass absence. Existing route naming/HTTPS checks are not Admin access controls.
requirements.criterion: Admin URL exposure restricted; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
Forms include CSRF tokens (form_key); assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: An input named form_key can be empty and current detector passes it; server acceptance is untested.
requirements.proposed_check: For the explicit discovered state-changing browser route manifest, automated integration tests must reject missing/invalid token without mutation and accept a valid token only with the appropriate authenticated session; incomplete route enumeration is UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Valid session-bound token succeeds in sandbox; public safe GET is excluded by route metadata.
tests.fail: Missing/empty/foreign-session token performs the state change.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: Run mutation tests in isolated environment, not as a passive production probe; this is route-contract coverage rather than all possible CSRF.

requirements.criterion: SSRF protections present; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Timeout/allowlist words near a sink do not establish URL canonicalization, DNS rebinding handling or redirect controls across arbitrary application flows.
required_inputs: controlled DNS and redirect test service in isolated network
requirements.proposed_check: For every HTTP-client adapter in the complete declared manifest, isolated automated tests must prove its approved destination policy rejects loopback/private/link-local destinations, DNS-change and redirect escape cases before connection, and allows the approved control. Unlisted adapters or incomplete network fixtures are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Known-safe adapter rejects loopback/private/redirect targets and permits approved destinations in controlled tests.
tests.fail: Adapter reaches a controlled forbidden target or unused guard suppresses a dangerous source sink.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: No defensible positive conclusion for the original broad requirement; arbitrary dynamic/network flows are not enumerated.

requirements.criterion: No eval/assert/dynamic execution; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Detector suppresses some unresolved includes/callables and interprets assert without installed-version semantics; current absence result cannot establish broad no dynamic execution.
requirements.proposed_check: Completely parsed custom PHP must contain no eval, executable-string assertion, create_function or dynamic include target outside a statically resolved approved set; unresolved constructs yield UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Literal installed-file include and ordinary assertion of a boolean pass the version-aware policy.
tests.fail: eval, dynamic request-controlled include and executable-string assertion on affected runtime fail.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: New precisely enumerated construct policy; dynamic language/runtime loading beyond analyzed files remains uncovered.

tests.safe: Controlled adapter rejects encoded traversal, symlink escape and sibling-prefix tricks.
tests.fail: A controlled read/write escapes the approved root despite nearby unused normalization.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: Business allowed types, image transformations, virus processing and CDN/runtime execution are broader than source inference.

tests.fail: Declared generator uses mt_rand or silently falls back after entropy-source failure.

requirements.proposed_check: Completely parsed custom PHP must use only approved crypto/session service APIs; ban a versioned exact list of raw session and obsolete crypto primitives, resolve aliases and report unresolved dynamic calls UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Approved Magento encryption/session service usage passes the explicit API policy.
tests.fail: Direct session_start or prohibited raw cipher invocation fails independently of unrelated framework imports.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.rationale: Whether rotation is configured for deployed logs can be automatically determined from effective scheduler/collector configurations. A project devops/logrotate.conf with compression does not prove host installation, all log coverage or container/cloud applicability.
required_inputs: Actual application log destinations and deployment logging architecture
Effective installed logrotate includes and schedule, or supported container/cloud collector retention configuration
requirements.proposed_check: Bind every configured application log sink to active rotation/retention configuration through supported host/container/cloud adapters. Resolve includes, defaults, overrides and scheduling without invoking rotation scripts. Complete configured sink coverage PASS; known unrotated sink FAIL; unsupported collector or missing include/scheduler UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Installed scheduler plus effective rules cover each file sink; supported container driver max-size/max-file policy.
tests.fail: One deployed log sink has no rotation rule or active scheduler.
tests.missing: Only repository sample config, unreadable include, unknown cloud sink or scheduler UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Original criterion is configured rotation, not successful historical execution. Retention/compression thresholds must be explicit policy; don't force local logrotate on managed logging.
requirements.criterion: Log rotation configured; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Risk can be an explicit machine-evaluable source policy: a complete mapping of replacements/forks/source overrides and exact approved upstreams/revisions permits a full verdict under that supplied policy. Current repository_trusted/is_fork heuristics and excluded missing sources are insufficient.
required_inputs: Complete lock plus root repository declarations
Canonical source URLs and pinned upstream revisions
requirements.proposed_check: Enumerate all collected replacement and source-override candidates from complete lock/root repository declarations; resolve canonical upstream and source revision; reject candidates violating configured exact repository/revision risk policy. Unknown identity, fork state, unsupported provider or source must prevent PASS.

tests.safe: All explicitly inventoried candidates meet the precise proposed check with complete known statuses. Verify applicable alternatives and exclusions explicitly.
tests.fail: Root repository source override or fork revision violates exact source policy; unknown no-replace package source cannot be silently excluded.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.

requirements.limitations: Conditional FULL under an explicit technical fork-risk policy; cannot infer absence of undisclosed malicious commits. Root repository overrides, non-Git providers, missing statuses and all installed custom libraries must be accounted for. No current authoritative revision allowlist adapter is claimed implemented.

HTTPS-only endpoints configured; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Host OUTPUT default deny alone is not deployment allow-list enforcement: jumps, broad accepts, IPv6, container FORWARD/CNI and external gateways may bypass it. Source hints cannot repair missing topology.

Explicit destination allow-list and complete IPv4/IPv6 chain references

Model complete chain ordering/jumps and both address families; unsupported paths UNKNOWN. No arbitrary external connection scans.

tests.safe: Complete supported ruleset permits only named destinations and necessary established traffic.
tests.fail: Early or jumped unconditional accept, IPv6 bypass or broad destination rule.
tests.missing: Unresolved chain, unreadable CNI/namespace policy, missing allow-list or unbound identity UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: New ID required for supported namespace/policy model; cannot certify all production network paths from host firewall output. A DROP policy with unrestricted earlier rules must not PASS.

requirements.rationale: Current check returns on the first apparently strong repository TLS declaration; other virtual hosts/gateways, inherited settings and TLS 1.3 cipher policy are not established. Active endpoint enumeration can support a precise observed policy.
required_inputs: Explicit gateway endpoint/SNI list with deployment binding
Supported active TLS cipher enumerator and explicit versioned cipher baseline
requirements.proposed_check: New ID: every successfully enumerated supplied gateway endpoint accepts only cipher suites allowed by configured baseline for assessed TLS versions. Any weak accepted suite FAIL; incomplete enumeration, unsupported client capability or unbound endpoint UNKNOWN. Source expressions are supplemental, not runtime proof.

tests.safe: Complete TLS 1.2/1.3 enumeration yields only allowed suites at every supplied endpoint.
tests.fail: One accepted deprecated suite or weak second gateway despite strong first config.
tests.missing: Enumerator cannot offer excluded suites, unknown SNI, handshake transport error or incomplete gateway list UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: New ID required for enumerated endpoint scope and defined strong-suite policy. Protocol/certificate checks do not cover ciphers; no browser/client failure may be interpreted as server rejection.
requirements.criterion: Strong TLS ciphers on upstream gateways; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.proposed_check: New ID: each supplied successfully retrieved checkout response emits enforced CSP satisfying configured directives after parsing each policy and applicable fallback. Report-only alone FAIL; policy split across unrelated files cannot combine into PASS; unavailable checkout/session UNKNOWN.

tests.fail: Report-only only, wildcard/unsafe policy violating baseline, or missing directive on an assessed successful page.
tests.missing: Login redirect, empty cart redirect, blocked session, unvisited route or unparseable response UNKNOWN.

Explicit approved global role policy with stable IDs and deployment binding

Do not silently treat omitted approval policy as empty; explicit deny-all policy is valid. Orphan/cyclic/unsupported ACL semantics UNKNOWN or assignment-integrity FAIL in MB-0100. tests.fail: Unapproved inherited/direct global role grant.

requirements.criterion: Global Admin ACL limited to approved roles; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Original criterion is explicitly a PCI vendor-default-account evidence assessment, not a defined technical predicate. Parsing a customer assertion JSON does not independently verify account security and cannot justify moving it to automated Magebean coverage.
required_inputs: Vendor-specific deployed account inventory and manufacturer defaults, if a separate technical control is desired
requirements.proposed_check: Keep original assessment outside Magebean automated profiles. Optional new ID may detect named supported vendor default accounts from read-only inventories; never automatically attempt default passwords on production.

tests.safe: An evidence JSON claiming reviewed must never alone produce automated protection PASS.
tests.fail: Separate supported inventory detector finds a prohibited known default account.
tests.missing: Missing vendor scope or independent account inventory remains UNKNOWN for any proposed technical detector.

requirements.limitations: PCI provenance and evidence sufficiency belong to PCI workflow. Separate default-account detection cannot certify the original assurance assessment.
requirements.criterion: PCI vendor default account evidence assessment; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: The minimum accepted native Admin password length can be determined from effective configuration and the installed validator. Legacy implementation reads only config.php; active MB-0728 already improves observation but does not test actual acceptance or custom validator overrides.
required_inputs: Effective Admin authentication mode and resolved password settings
Installed validator version, DI preferences/plugins and supported nonmutating validation adapter
requirements.proposed_check: Verify native Admin password validator rejects valid-form candidates shorter than eight and resolves an effective minimum at least eight; adapter runs validation without creating users or changing passwords. Unsupported IMS/custom authentication UNKNOWN. Prefer consolidate with MB-0728 if its existing narrower criterion remains explicit.

tests.safe: Native minimum eight rejects seven-character candidates and accepts an otherwise valid eight-character candidate.
tests.fail: Installed validator accepts a valid seven-character candidate.
tests.missing: IMS or unsupported validator override, unavailable settings or validation adapter yields UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Does not inspect plaintext passwords or prove every existing credential meets the current policy. Eight is Magebean policy, not a universal Adobe mandate.
requirements.criterion: Admin passwords require at least 8 characters; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
No raw SQL without abstraction; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Raw-SQL abstraction and injection safety are different properties; current regex also flags fixed SQL literals and does not resolve the connection type.
required_inputs: PHP AST and resolved adapter types
requirements.proposed_check: In every parsed PHP/PHTML file in the declared complete custom-code inventory, database calls must resolve to approved Magento adapters/repositories and parameter binding; unresolved dynamic receiver or query construction is UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Bound Magento adapter query passes the binding policy; fixed SQL has a separate abstraction verdict.
tests.fail: Direct mysqli/PDO call outside approved adapter policy; concatenated request value fails.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: Interprocedural dynamic SQL and plugins require analysis coverage; this new policy does not prove no SQL injection.

requirements.criterion: Template output is escaped; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Regex recognizes a subset of echoes and any escape-function name; HTML, attribute, URL and JS contexts require distinct handling.
requirements.proposed_check: Every output expression in completely parsed custom PHTML templates must use the encoder approved for its syntactic HTML/attribute/URL context or resolve to an explicitly typed trusted rendered fragment; dynamic contexts are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: escapeHtml in HTML text and escapeHtmlAttr in quoted attribute pass their respective context checks.
tests.fail: Unescaped dynamic output and escapeHtml used in a JS string fail the context policy.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: No browser/runtime XSS guarantee; Knockout/JS-generated output is outside this new PHTML policy.

requirements.criterion: No unsafe deserialization; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Current allowed_classes=false bypass is not sufficient for untrusted data; PHP documentation explicitly warns against it.
requirements.proposed_check: In completely parsed custom PHP files, no invocation may resolve to native unserialize, including namespace aliases/fully-qualified and statically resolvable indirect calls; unresolved callable targets are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: JSON decoder use passes the explicit native-unserialize ban.
tests.fail: Native unserialize with allowed_classes=false, true or missing option fails the policy.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: This is a stricter API ban with a new criterion; it does not prove all serializers and object-hydration flows safe.

requirements.criterion: Command execution is guarded; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Fixture shows unrelated escapeshellarg causes PASS for unguarded shell_exec; guard presence is not dataflow.
requirements.proposed_check: No parsed custom-code call may resolve to shell-enabled execution APIs or backticks; only approved process adapter calls with literal executable and array arguments are allowed, unresolved indirect targets are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Approved process adapter with fixed executable and separate argument vector passes.
tests.fail: shell_exec of request input fails even with unrelated escapeshellarg nearby.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: New explicit execution API policy, not proof every OS command is semantically harmless.

requirements.criterion: Escaping for JS context; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Inline JS output requires nested HTML/JS parsing; finding an encoder name is insufficient.
requirements.proposed_check: All dynamic output in completely parsed inline-script and event-handler contexts must use the approved context-specific serializer/encoder combination; unresolved script templates are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Correct JSON data serialization for script context including HTML delimiters passes.
tests.fail: Raw request output inside a JS quoted literal fails; unrelated escapeJs call must not suppress it.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: External JS/DOM sinks remain outside this bounded policy; no general XSS assurance.

requirements.criterion: Sensitive data not logged; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Source snippets neither enumerate downstream handlers nor prove every sensitive value is redacted.
requirements.proposed_check: For the declared application logging pipeline and sensitive-field schema, synthetic canary values must be removed or irreversibly masked before every configured sink receives each defined event fixture.

tests.safe: All configured handlers receive redacted fixtures including nested fields and exceptions.
tests.fail: Any sink receives raw canary token/password from a defined event fixture.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: New schema/event-bound contract; unknown sensitive fields and historical logs remain outside tested coverage.

requirements.rationale: Loaded Xdebug extension/mode state is machine observable for actual production workers. Current repository ini scan and absence of Xdebug HTTP headers do not identify web SAPI state or environment overrides.
required_inputs: Read-only authenticated worker-local runtime telemetry for every declared PHP pool/container
Loaded extension list, Xdebug effective mode and environment overrides with release/pool binding
requirements.proposed_check: Assess actual workers: Xdebug extension absent PASS under disabled-extension policy; loaded extension FAIL if that policy forbids loading, or effective off only under explicit mode policy. No public phpinfo endpoint. Incomplete fleet telemetry UNKNOWN; never substitute scanner CLI php -i.

tests.safe: All declared pools report Xdebug absent with matching deployment identities.
tests.fail: One worker loads Xdebug or effective debugging mode contrary to policy despite clean repository ini.
tests.missing: Only CLI ini, missing pool telemetry, stale snapshot or unknown XDEBUG_MODE override UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Define disabled semantics explicitly. Active MB-0729 covers inspected declarations only; absence of debug headers is not absence of Xdebug.
requirements.criterion: Xdebug disabled in production; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Effective display_errors is machine observable in the application PHP runtime. Current project ini parsing ignores pool/server overrides and treats every observed declaration equally instead of resolving precedence.
required_inputs: Bound read-only actual web-worker runtime settings for each deployment pool
Effective display_errors after applicable ini/pool/runtime overrides
requirements.proposed_check: Verify effective display_errors is Off for each assessed runtime pool through trusted nonpublic telemetry. Enabled value FAIL, complete all-Off PASS, unavailable worker/value UNKNOWN. Do not intentionally trigger production errors as proof.

tests.safe: Every worker reports effective Off despite overridden historical On declaration.
tests.fail: A pool/runtime override enables display_errors despite project ini Off.
tests.missing: Absent telemetry or stale/pool-mismatched snapshot UNKNOWN; clean homepage alone cannot PASS.

requirements.limitations: Point-in-time runtime value does not prove code never later changes it; unsupported request-specific overrides must remain UNKNOWN or separately scoped.
requirements.criterion: display_errors is Off; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Native template-hint settings can be resolved automatically across deployment store scopes. Existing env.php-only lookup marks absent values safe and misses database/store overrides.
required_inputs: Resolved env/config/DB/module defaults plus environment config overrides for template-hint paths
requirements.proposed_check: Resolve native template hints including applicable store inheritance for every active production scope; all resolved disabled PASS, any enabled FAIL, unknown effective value or unsupported override UNKNOWN. Deduplicate MB-0742 through a combined implementation while retaining criterion mapping.

tests.safe: Installed defaults disabled and inherited across all enumerated scopes.
tests.fail: One store-specific template_hints=1 overrides disabled default.
tests.missing: Unknown store inventory, missing DB permissions or custom config reader UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Active default-scope declaration check is partial. Does not assess arbitrary extension debugging output or unenumerated deployments.
requirements.criterion: No dev debug configs on production (template hints off); assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Effective cache frontend backend identities can be inspected automatically in supported Magento deployments. Active MB-0038 already covers the declared Redis/Varnish policy; original absence-of-file backend needs resolved defaults/overrides, not a Redis-only allow-list that rejects every safe custom backend.
required_inputs: Resolved effective default/page-cache frontend backend configuration
Installed backend class identity/adapter mapping, Varnish applicability and runtime override inventory
requirements.proposed_check: Resolve actual default/page-cache backend selection and fallback for supported backend implementations; any file backend FAIL, every selected supported non-file backend PASS, unknown custom backend semantics UNKNOWN. Prefer consolidate with MB-0038 where declaration policy is intended.

tests.safe: Resolved Redis default and Redis/Varnish page cache; supported non-file adapter.
tests.fail: Absent effective default frontend falls back to filesystem, or explicit file page cache.
tests.missing: Unsupported backend class, unresolved DI/runtime override or malformed config UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Cache selection is readiness policy, not proof of vulnerability or service health. Do not add a duplicate declaration check merely to restore the old count.
requirements.criterion: No dev cache backends (avoid file backend); assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Debug template hints are native resolvable settings, but legacy check also inspects inline translation and does not resolve stores/defaults. Clarify the implementation against original hints criterion rather than conflating independent settings.
required_inputs: All production store scopes and resolved template_hints_storefront/template_hints settings
Installed module defaults and applicable config overrides
requirements.proposed_check: Resolve and require native template hint values disabled in every active production scope. Share collector/check with MB-0740 and consolidate duplicates if criteria are semantically equal; separately report inline translation under its own defined predicate.

tests.safe: All resolved storefront hints disabled.
tests.fail: Store-specific storefront hints enabled while default scope is off.
tests.missing: Unresolved setting, unreadable installed defaults or partial scope inventory UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: Do not count two near-duplicate template-hint requirements as two independent security capabilities. Existing active requirement covers only default-scope declarations.
requirements.criterion: Debug template hints disabled in production; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
PII not logged in application logs; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: It reuses MB-0737 detector but PII classification is different; matching a customer/email word does not prove disclosure.
requirements.proposed_check: For declared PII fields and event fixtures, every configured application-log sink must receive values transformed according to the declared masking policy; unknown sinks are UNKNOWN.

tests.safe: Synthetic customer/email/address fixture is masked to the defined policy in all captured sinks.
tests.fail: A defined event sends raw synthetic PII to any captured sink.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: New bounded PII policy; no claim that arbitrary logs contain no PII. Share collection with MB-0737 but keep distinct conclusions.

requirements.rationale: Abandonment is an explicit package-maintenance status and can be machine-verified for a complete collected library inventory. Existing active MB-0061 already provides this for Composer libraries. Original full criterion can be satisfied only if all collected libraries are covered, including untyped/non-Composer libraries where present.
required_inputs: Per-package explicit abandonment status from dated authoritative source
Non-Composer library inventory if claiming all libraries
requirements.proposed_check: Reuse MB-0061 for Composer libraries; inventory additional collected libraries with authoritative package identifiers and explicit known abandonment status for every item. Any unresolved identity or status prevents PASS.

tests.safe: All Composer and non-Composer libraries have explicit abandonment=false; missing package type must not hide a library.
tests.fail: One known violation of the precise proposed predicate fails even with missing statuses for other items; preserve redacted package/path evidence.
tests.missing: Missing, malformed, stale, unsupported, partial or unreadable input => UNKNOWN; never PASS.

requirements.limitations: Conditional on complete collected library inventory and authoritative current per-library status. Merely filtering Composer type=library does not prove all libraries covered. This is overlap with an active check, not a net-new check for Composer-only deployments.
requirements.criterion: No abandoned libraries allowed; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.

requirements.rationale: Regex matching debug/logging keys and integration-like context cannot exhaust third-party integrations; ordinary enabled logging is not necessarily verbose secret-bearing debug. Current absence-of-key PASS overclaims.
required_inputs: Versioned vendor config schema mapping of actual debug/verbose paths and resolved scope values
requirements.proposed_check: New ID: every debug/verbose setting for explicitly supported installed integration/version adapters is resolved disabled in named scopes. Unsupported integrations remain reported UNKNOWN, rather than treating absent regex matches as clean. Ordinary audit logging excluded unless vendor schema explicitly marks debug.

tests.safe: Supported gateway debug off with ordinary audit logging on.
tests.fail: Known vendor debug key resolves on in a store override.
tests.missing: Unknown integration/version, missing schema or inaccessible setting UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: New ID required for named supported integrations; cannot infer every third-party component behavior from generic key names.
requirements.criterion: Debug/verbose off for third-party integrations; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
Third-party logging sanitized (mask/redact); assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.rationale: Third-party API responses and nested SDK log processors can bypass superficial redact-string matches.
requirements.proposed_check: Each declared third-party logging adapter must redact all schema-listed secret/PII canaries from request, response, exception and retry fixtures before the adapter emits to its configured sink.

tests.safe: Nested request/response and exception canaries are masked before emission.
tests.fail: SDK debug/retry logger emits a raw canary despite an unused sanitizer method.
tests.missing: Missing/unreadable/oversized/malformed eligible inputs, truncated inventory or unresolved analysis must be UNKNOWN; no conversion to manual evidence and no PASS from zero files.

requirements.limitations: New adapter-contract policy; newly introduced integrations need manifest updates.

requirements.rationale: Arbitrary executable content cannot be excluded by a finite signature set; current legacy detector skips oversized/unreadable files and can PASS an empty inventory.
required_inputs: Configured signature/extension policy and server handler inventory
requirements.proposed_check: New ID: no configured PHP opening-tag, executable-extension or script-handler signatures in readable eligible files across named upload paths; eligible unreadable/oversized files or unfollowed symlinks UNKNOWN. Extend active MB-0780 only within its filename predicate, not as proof of all executable-code absence.

tests.safe: Complete benign inventory and inert strings handled under explicit signature policy.
tests.fail: PHP payload disguised as jpg; .phtml double extension; upload .htaccess handler directive.
tests.missing: Missing root, oversized eligible file, symlink or incomplete traversal yields UNKNOWN.

requirements.limitations: New ID required because a signature policy is weaker than absence of executable code. Never execute suspected files; filename inventory does not establish server execution prevention.
requirements.criterion: No executable code in media or upload paths; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
